# macjulian.com

Julian is a product designer and builder based in London, working at the intersection of AI, fintech, and consumer software. He designs products that turn complex technology into experiences that just work — shipping fast with early-stage startups and owning the full journey from strategy to interaction.

## Pages

- / — Home: bio, selected case studies, indie apps, and recent activity
- /about — Background, design philosophy, and personal interests
- /work — Full portfolio of case studies (AI tools, fintech, crypto, travel)
- /built — Side projects and indie apps built and shipped independently
- /journal — Writing on product design, AI, and building software
- /now — A daily log of what Julian is currently working on
- /writing — Essays and longer-form writing on design and technology
- /motion-lab — Experiments in motion design and interactive UI

## Selected Work

- Ithaca Protocol — Designing trust in an AI-powered options trading system
- Claystack — Designing the Ethereum liquid staking UX
- Symmetry AI — Improving AI responses by bringing user context into every chat
